identity: In order to make our reports sound less like we're just staring at goats, we've been instructed to designate all phenomena resulting from the matrix crystals with the label "Netherum mathematics."  That makes L61 our first "mathematician."  Maybe they won't suddenly cut our funding if we obfuscate things that way.
